Why 10 minutes of finger play beats flashcards for preschool & early-elementary brain growth 🖐️🧠

Over 30% of the human sensorimotor cortex is dedicated to the thumb and fingertips (Penfield Homunculus), and fine-motor precision is the #1 longitudinal predictor of elementary math achievement (Developmental Psychology).
